fund_id.rationale: Ticker symbol uniquely identifies each fund row.

ticker.rationale: Same column serves as exchange ticker.

fund_family.rationale: Sponsor names (DWS, Invesco, etc.) are the asset manager/AMC.

category.rationale: Peer Group values match Morningstar-style category names (Large Value, Mid-Cap Value, etc.).

expense_ratio.rationale: Mixed bps/percent text; code parses explicit suffixes per value into a fraction.

category_expense_ratio.rationale: Numeric range 0.45-1.79 indicates percent, not fraction; convert to fraction.

risk_score.rationale: Five-level word scale maps directly onto 1-5 risk scale.

category_return_5y.rationale: Median 8.17 indicates category average percent return.

total_net_assets.rationale: Text like '$2.98B' parsed directly by code; no multiplier needed.

inception_date.rationale: Sample '07/30/2007' has day=30>12, so format is month/day/year.

as_of_date.rationale: Format like 'Nov 24, 2021' matches month-abbrev day, year pattern.

return_1y.rationale: Median 21.13 indicates percent values, convert to fraction return.
